data.name: CameraFlow
data.shortDescription: CameraFlow - Make your own cinematic camera paths.
data.description:
#Camera Flow
**This mod allows you to create your own paths to make cinematic videos of your builds or the beautiful scenery.**


##Features:
- Place points wherever you want to form your path
- An editing menu to adjust individual points, delete or add points as well as change to desired rotation of the camera.
- A preview to show you how the camera will move to perfectly align the path through a window.
- Easily save your path to create comparisons or show off the progress of your build.


##Configuration:
*In the Configuration you can set different Keybinds and adjust the Settings for your needs.*
- Change the speed to get your desired look
- Adjust the keybinds to whatever you prefer
- Keep godmode enabled, so your can build undisturbed.
- If you want to go into further detail you can adjust the Resolution value, higher values can lead to better results, but also to lag during calculation. In most cases the default value should be sufficient.


##Important information:
- The Saved Paths are located in: "Sons Of The Forest\Mods\CameraFlow\"


####In case of anything going wrong please save before using the mod!**

Source Code can be found here: https://github.com/laserman120/CameraFlow-A-Sons-of-the-Forest-Cinematic-Camera-Mod
